scripts.start: npm run build && node dist-cli/aldunis-code.js start
scripts.test: tsx --test server/*.test.ts desktop/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/lib/**/*.test.ts src/components/ui/*.test.ts src/features/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: tsx --test desktop/lifecycle.test.ts desktop/remote-environments.test.ts desktop/updater.test.ts server/browser-mcp.test.ts server/browser.test.ts server/changes.test.ts server/delivery.test.ts server/directory-browser.test.ts server/host-*.test.ts server/managed-host.test.ts server/preview.test.ts server/provider*.test.ts server/release-candidate.test.ts server/release-delivery-workflow.test.ts server/remote-auth.test.ts server/repository.test.ts server/state.test.ts server/worktrees.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint:changed && tsx scripts/check-whitespace.ts
scripts.verify: npm run validate && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:desktop-main: esbuild desktop/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:electron-updater --external:proper-lockfile --external:@grpc/grpc-js --external:@grpc/proto-loader --external:@iarna/toml --outfile=dist-electron/main.js && esbuild desktop/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs && esbuild server/shikigami-permission-hook.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/shikigami-permission-hook.mjs && esbuild server/browser-mcp.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/browser-mcp.mjs
scripts.build:cli: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:proper-lockfile --external:@grpc/grpc-js --external:@grpc/proto-loader --external:@iarna/toml --outfile=dist-cli/aldunis-code.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && esbuild server/permission-mcp.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-cli/permission-mcp.mjs && esbuild server/shikigami-permission-hook.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-cli/shikigami-permission-hook.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop-main && npm run build:cli

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aldunis Code uses the microphone only when you activate voice input to transcribe a prompt.
